create_xlm_model: create an XLM transformer model with configurable layers, heads, and embeddings for multilingual text
build_xlm_language_model: build an XLM language modeling head on top of the transformer with tied embeddings
test_xlm_sequence_classification: test the XLM sequence classification head for GLUE tasks with configurable label count
run_xlm_question_answering: run extractive question answering on XLM hidden states with start and end span prediction
review_multihead_attention: review the multi-head self-attention mechanism with causal masking and KV caching support
